name: Ethereum

key_findings: Scored as L1 only, PoS era only -- all L2 rollup activity excluded from every metric.
Quantum Resistance Partial cap (88) sits above the raw (84.00) and does not bind.
Developer & Ecosystem (90) and TradFi Approved (90) are among the highest category scores on the board.
First chain in framework history where an AI gate cap was present but did not bind -- raw 74.01 sits one point below the 75 Deterministic Finality Partial cap.
Execution Layer (62) is dragged mainly by ~13-15 minute hard finality, roughly two orders of magnitude slower than XRP.
KYA (83) is the clear category leader on the board, driven by ERC-8004 being ETH's native, chain-agnostic standard.

TradFi 84 vs AI 74 is a broad-based ~10-point divergence from three distinct structural weaknesses (slow finality, adversarial MEV/fee environment, weak L1 privacy) rather than one dominant gate wall.

watch_items: Post-Dencun burn collapse may warrant a Tokenomics revision from 80 toward 76-78 in a future re-assessment.
Fusaka/Glamsterdam roadmap items (single-slot finality, Verkle trees, PeerDAS) could materially shift Execution Layer if shipped.
